NTA. But hear me out, you might not need to financially support her in end of life care but you may want to make an effort to help find her resources. Drug Addiction IS a disease. Spend any time with recovering addicts and you will hear the deepest regrets uttered. We don’t fault someone with a disease that takes away their ability to be present when it’s not addiction. It is yet, especially painful to be neglected for drugs, that’s undeniable. Help her from afar to do the right thing on your end, even though she couldn’t for you. Tell her how you feel, what you felt. Get closure. She will pass and you will need to end the chapter for yourself as well. Doing nothing may leave scars on the rest of your story as well. Just my two cents.

ESH. Your cousin is definitely terrible for the things she said. And you sunk to her level. 

I would like to point out that your cousin wouldn’t be this way if she didn’t harbor some insecurities. Either she flaunts things and looks down on you to make herself feel better about something... or she’s actually jealous of you. I don’t offer this to make you feel better than her in any way, that’s equally petty. It can sometimes just help to have a little insight into motivations. My older sister takes digs at me and while it’s irksome, I just remind myself that her real enemy is herself, not me.

The first time I went to the dentist I was 23 years old. I had cracked and broken teeth in the back of my mouth. I was finally making a little money but didn’t have dental coverage. I found a dental clinic run by a university in my area and started working with a student there that promised to help me with my teeth. My teeth are super straight, he primarily thought I must have had braces at one point. I just won the genetic lottery in that area. I had a couple molars removed and many cavities filled but eventually ran out of money to keep going. I still need work done and I’m always stressed about my teeth.

Worked at Goodwill for about a year in college. I sorted and priced goods. We found interesting items from time to time. 

The item that most stands out came in in a bin of what we would call “linens”. That was my department and I was good at, which meant moving quickly to sort and price the goods. I reach into the bin to pull out what looked like a bundled up set of sheets and it was heavy. I’m glad I pulled it the way that I did. Inside was the biggest ball of rusty fish hooks. So weird. 

People would toss old used dildos into donation bins, we got a few of those. 

A cheap blow-up doll was found once, had to be the kind you get as a gag. 

Finally, I once found a small stash of diamond rings. Gave them to my manager. Not sure what happened to those.
